report:
Left lower lobe wedge

Received fresh, a wedge of lung tissue measuring 6 x 3 x 2 cm. The parenchymal margin is inked black. Sectioning reveals a firm tan-white nodule measuring 0.8 cm across, 0.5 cm from the staple-line margin. The overlying pleura is puckered. Representative sections of the nodule are embedded in 2 frozen blocks, and subsequently converted to paraffin blocks; the remaining tissue is submitted for paraffin sections only.

(1-2) Tumour with pleura (frozen blocks).
(3) Staple-line margin.
(4) Background lung.

Adenocarcinoma; parenchymal margin clear (5 mm).

The paraffin sections confirm the frozen section diagnosis. They show adenocarcinoma, acinar predominant.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Wedge resection
- Laterality: Left
- Lobe(s): Lower lobe
- Tumour site: Peripheral
- Tumour size: 8 mm in greatest dimension
- Invasive size (lepidic component excluded): 8 mm
- Separate tumour nodule(s): Not identified
- Pleural surface (gross): Puckered

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Invasive adenocarcinoma, acinar predominant (acinar 70 %,
  lepidic 30 %)
- Histologic grade: Grade 2 (IASLC 2020; acinar predominant, no high-grade
  pattern)
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show an invasive adenocarcinoma, acinar predominant (acinar 70 %, lepidic 30 %). The acinar areas consist of round to oval malignant glands set in fibrous stroma. The tumour cells are cuboidal to columnar with eosinophilic to vacuolated cytoplasm, enlarged nuclei showing vesicular chromatin and conspicuous nucleoli, and infiltrate a desmoplastic stroma. Immunohistochemistry: TTF-1 positive, napsin A positive.
- Spread through air spaces (STAS): Not identified
- Visceral pleura invasion: Not identified
- Lymphatic and / or vascular invasion: Not identified
- Tumour extension: Not applicable
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy

Margins
- Bronchial margin: Not applicable
- Vascular margin: Not applicable
- Parenchymal margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma (closest distance 5 mm)

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: Not submitted

Distant metastasis
- Distant metastasis: Not applicable

Pathological stage (AJCC 9th edition)
- pTNM: pT1a pNX
  - Stage group (if cM0): IA1

Additional findings
- None

LUNG, left lower lobe, wedge excision x frozen section
- INVASIVE ADENOCARCINOMA, acinar predominant, 8 mm, visceral pleura not
  invaded; parenchymal margin clear; see synoptic report
- pT1a pNX (AJCC 9th edition), stage IA1 (if cM0)
